source_passage_summary.short_exact_source: Reception is when two Planets that are significators in any Question or matter, are in each others dignity
source_passage_summary.interpretation: The two must be acting as significators, not merely any random natal planets. Reciprocal house and reciprocal exaltation planetary zodiac configurations are computable potential receptions, not automatically a valid psychological/ruler designation.

source_passage_summary.source_report: Sun Aries and Mars Leo are reciprocal by houses; reception can also be by triplicity, terms or face, and does not always require an aspect. This particular p115 point table awards +5 mutual by house or +4 reception by exaltation; these are not automatically two extra bonuses for a planet already intrinsically in the same dignity channel.

source_passage_summary.short_exact_source: A Planet is then said to be Peregrine, when he is in the degrees of any Signe wherein he hath no essentiall dignity
source_passage_summary.source_examples: Saturn at 10 Aries is peregrine; at 27/28 Aries it is not, because of own term. Sun Cancer is peregrine throughout.
source_passage_summary.historical_ambiguity: Does a geometric mutual reception count as essential dignity at the natal body's own degree, thereby clearing the -5 peregrine penalty? The text does not settle this for all generic natal matter-significator candidates.

source_passage_summary.source_report: Detriment 5, fall 4, peregrine 5 are under Debilities; an adverse score is assigned -5/-4/-5 for an experimental partial-strength algebra. Detriment is opposite domicile, fall opposite exaltation, peregrine requires absence of the five essential dignities.
Domicile or mutual reception by houses 5, exaltation or reception by exaltation 4, with OR implying one scored channel, not double-add 5+5/4+4.

CVII's final dignity-at-Mercury/Moon-places is distinct from global natal body's own essential-dignity condition. This study scores each body's own degree and does not replace earlier S1/S2/S3/SX/S4/S5 selection.

historical_source_variants.sect_uncertain_threshold: ±0.1 degrees source solar altitude, modern conservative uncertainty not historical rule
historical_source_variants.geometric_reception_rules: Potential strict mutual domicile or same-kind exaltation by two DISTINCT classical bodies. Mixed-mode (one by house, one by exaltation), or other dignity pairings and actual matter-significator status are OPEN; not assigned.
historical_source_variants.peregrine_reception_status: SOURCE_AMBIGUITY: keep both clear and retain.
historical_source_variants.source_constrained_maximum_points: Only natal essential; no original p115 accidental house/motion, solar condition, aspects/nodes, fixed stars; no full Lilly manners ruler or Ptolemy soul governor.
